races.notes: 57th running of the Apple Cup and the season opener for VMRA's 40th Anniversary tour. Cheth #23 led home Quatsoe #8 and Woods #22.

races.winner_note: Woods dominated the Evergreen half-mile to pull within striking distance of the lead.
races.notes: Round 2 saw a classic Evergreen battle. Woods #22 took the win, with Cheth #23 and Jones #30 rounding out the podium.

races.winner_note: Josh 'The Jet' Van Winkle took the #5 car to the winner's circle.
races.notes: The weekend at Evergreen concluded with a spectacular performance by Van Winkle.

races.winner_note: Swept the night — fast time, heat win, and the full 25 in the main. The 80 points on the day moved #68 from 4th to the season lead at 211.
races.notes: Round 3 of the 40th Anniversary tour at Wenatchee Valley Super Oval's quarter-mile. Hecter Jr's clean sweep was the story; Cheth #23 and Quatsoe #8 followed in the standings.

races.event: Thunder in the Valley Open Wheel Show
races.winner_note: Took the full 25 in the main and 69 on the night in the Northwest Concrete Cutting 82.
races.notes: Round 8 of the 40th Anniversary tour at the Wenatchee Valley Super Oval's quarter-mile, and the seventh points-paying round of the season. Conwell #82 won the feature. Hecter Jr #68 took quick time and the biggest points haul of the night at 75, extending the season lead to 479. D. Eierman #76 and K. Gill #65 scored their first points of 2026.

winner.name: Bart Hecter Sr / Bart Hecter Jr

races.winner_note: Took the full 25 in the main and 78 on the night, the best score in the field.
races.notes: Round 9 of the 40th Anniversary tour and the eighth points-paying round. The #68 won the feature, with Strimple #57 second after a heat win and Cheth #23 third. Quatsoe #8 set fast time but finished sixth in the main, so the 68's lead grew to 27 at 557. Roundtree #10 had his best night of the year with 63, and S. Conduff scored 53 in the 31's first start. Fourteen cars took the green.

races.notes: Round 10 of the 40th Anniversary tour and the ninth and final points-paying round. Cheth #23 won the feature ahead of the #68 and Conwell #82. The 68 clinched the 2026 championship on 616. Cheth and Quatsoe #8 finished tied on 580; Cheth takes second on main-event finish. Woods #22 set fast time. Thirteen cars started.
